Subject: New vendor onboarding - compliance & supplier diversity forms

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intake form last week — we9re excited to get set up as an approved supplier for Redwood. Attached are our supplier diversity certificate and a short ESG summary that covers scope, emissions baseline and a couple of policies (anti-slavery, human rights).

Files attached: GreenForge_Supplier_Diversity_Cert.pdf (pdf), GreenForge_ESG_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet).

A few quick asks from our side as we kick this off:
- Is there a preferred PO number format so we can match invoices automatically?
- Who should we expect as the primary contact for payment/PO follow-ups?
- Any required vendor banking form or portal link to complete?

If helpful, we can hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the docs.

Best,

amelia@greenforge.io | +1 (415) 555-0134

Hi Amelia,

Appreciate the packets and great to meet you. I9ll own the intake from here and loop in Procurement (Marissa) and Payments (Monica) for the PO/billing side.

Quick next steps from Redwood:
1) Please complete the attached Redwood Vendor Onboarding Checklist so we have the legal & tax fields in one place (I attached for your convenience).
2) We require a completed Modern Slavery / Forced Labor questionnaire for all new suppliers in your tier. I9m attaching the questionnaire request below — if you can return it by EOD Friday (2026-07-24) that would help us stay on a fast timeline.
3) For PO format: our PO numbers are RED-<4digit>-<YYYY>. Example: RED-0124-2026. Please include that format on invoices.
4) Primary payment contact: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com). She will reach out if she needs additional banking details or a voided check.

I9ve also added links to our vendor portal where you can register company info and upload the forms: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/register?company=greenforge

Let me know if Tuesday 07/21 at 10:00am PT works for a quick sync.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Sourcing Manager | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com | +1 (628) 555-0199
